evaluations.evidence: view a list of sponsors
evaluations.rationale: The requested capability is clear and has a single reasonable interpretation.

evaluations.evidence: view a list of user profiles
evaluations.rationale: The action and object are straightforward; no materially different interpretations are implied.

evaluations.evidence: email all the trainers at once from the website for info and updates
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous what “from the website” entails (UI form vs automated mailing), and what qualifies as “all the trainers” (role, current year, active trainers).

evaluations.evidence: a very clear map where the buildings and rooms are
evaluations.rationale: “Very clear map” is subjective and can be interpreted in materially different ways (interactive vs static, level of detail, accessibility).

evaluations.evidence: edit my training node myself ... and links to slides
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous scope of “edit” (which fields/sections) and unclear phrase “and links to slides” (add links? manage attachments? required?).

evaluations.evidence: limit to one registration per day per authenticated user
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous what “per day” means (calendar day vs event day) and what counts as a “registration” (training vs summit vs camp registration).

evaluations.evidence: admin view that helps track registration status ... if attendend, refunded, no show
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous set of statuses and definitions (e.g., “attended” vs “checked in”), and unclear whether statuses are selectable, computed, or both.

evaluations.evidence: be added to a training waitlist
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous waitlist behavior (automatic promotion vs manual, ordering rules, notifications).

evaluations.evidence: must accept the cancellation terms with a checkbox
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous what “cancellation terms” are (which text/version) and when/where the checkbox is presented in the flow.

evaluations.evidence: tie in a cancellation deadline to whatever registration / cancellation workflow exists
evaluations.rationale: “Whatever workflow exists” is underspecified and allows materially different implementations (enforcement point, deadline rules, affected registrations).

evaluations.evidence: add to "my schedule" if there is a schedule feature on the site
evaluations.rationale: Conditional phrasing makes the requirement unclear (whether the feature must exist) and “add to my schedule” could mean bookmarking, registration, or calendar export.

evaluations.evidence: see which trainings I have signed up for
evaluations.rationale: The requested information is clear: display the trainings the user is registered for.

evaluations.evidence: a view ... that shows all attendee information
evaluations.rationale: “All attendee information” is ambiguous (which fields, privacy constraints) and “attached to their training node” can be interpreted multiple ways (tab, block, embedded list).

evaluations.evidence: all trainee information is shown and can be filtered
evaluations.rationale: “All trainee information” is ambiguous and could lead to materially different data exposure/field sets.

evaluations.evidence: possibly a map view, datetime, skill level, registrations remaining
evaluations.rationale: “Possibly a map view” is ambiguous (optional vs conditional). Also “datetime” and “skill level” are not defined (format/scale), allowing different interpretations.

evaluations.evidence: clearly marked for the following information: day and time ... title ... remaining registrations ... register now link
evaluations.rationale: Despite “clearly marked” being mildly subjective, the required fields/links are enumerated, yielding a single material interpretation.

evaluations.evidence: intro section ... and promote call for trainings
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous what “intro section” contains and what “promote call for trainings” means (banner, CTA, submission link, timing).

evaluations.evidence: have a link on the home page to a list of training options
evaluations.rationale: Clear placement and target (home page link to training options list).

evaluations.evidence: find out where the coding lounge is and what time it is open
evaluations.rationale: The information requested (location and hours) is specific and not open to materially different interpretations.

evaluations.evidence: refund sponsorship money that was processed via stripe
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous scope and behavior of “refund” (full vs partial, multiple payments, fees) and which sponsorship transactions qualify.

evaluations.evidence: become a $350 level sponsor
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous what “$350 level sponsor” entails (benefits/role assignment) and what “sponsorships page” refers to if multiple pages exist.

evaluations.evidence: attendees associated with this company
evaluations.rationale: “Associated with this company” is ambiguous (self-declared employer, sponsorship purchaser, domain match, admin linkage).

evaluations.evidence: identify myself as and pay for a $350 company sponsorship
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous what “identify myself as” means (company name selection, verification) and what constitutes the $350 sponsorship (role, listing, benefits).

evaluations.evidence: create and maintain venues
evaluations.rationale: “Maintain venues” is ambiguous (edit fields, manage availability, delete/archive) and venue data scope is unspecified.

evaluations.evidence: view venue details ... and see the events happening there
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous what counts as “events” (sessions, trainings, summits) and what “happening there” means (current, upcoming, during conference dates).

evaluations.evidence: sessions associated with sponsor attendees
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous association rule (sessions those attendees present? registered for? speaking at?) leading to materially different outputs.

evaluations.evidence: See a payment page ... as the third step of the registration process
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous what “registration process” refers to (camp vs sponsorship vs training) and what constitutes “third step” if flows vary.

evaluations.evidence: assign sponsors to events, trainings and summits
evaluations.rationale: The relationship to be managed is clear (link sponsors to specified content types) and purpose is explicit.

evaluations.evidence: see all events, trainings and summits that a sponsor is sponsoring
evaluations.rationale: Clear query and result set: list items sponsored by a given sponsor.

evaluations.evidence: Enter payment information and have my card charged for an individual sponsorship
evaluations.rationale: The payment action and target (individual sponsorship) are clear enough for a single interpretation.

evaluations.evidence: link BADCamp attendees to my sponsorship page
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous what “link attendees” means (display list of attendees? associate attendee profiles? invite links?) and how linkage is established.

evaluations.evidence: update my user profile
evaluations.rationale: “User profile” update scope is ambiguous (which fields, privacy controls, avatar, social links), allowing materially different requirements.

evaluations.evidence: sign up for the BADCamp newsletter
evaluations.rationale: The requested capability (newsletter subscription) is clear and commonly understood.

evaluations.evidence: tag my blog posts for consumption by Drupal Planet
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous what “for consumption by Drupal Planet” requires (specific taxonomy term, RSS category, metadata, approval workflow).

evaluations.evidence: create blog posts
evaluations.rationale: The capability is straightforward and not open to materially different interpretations.

evaluations.evidence: read the blog
evaluations.rationale: Clear user goal: view blog content.

evaluations.evidence: sponsor a summit that matches my brand
evaluations.rationale: “Matches my brand” is subjective and can be interpreted in materially different ways (category tags, manual selection, recommendation).

evaluations.evidence: register for a summit
evaluations.rationale: The action is clear: allow an attendee to register for a summit.

evaluations.evidence: get detailed directions to the summit venue
evaluations.rationale: “Detailed directions” is ambiguous (map link vs step-by-step, transit/parking info, starting point assumptions).

evaluations.evidence: see what summits I'm signed up for
evaluations.rationale: Clear list of the user’s summit registrations.

evaluations.evidence: see a list of attendees signed up for my summit
evaluations.rationale: The requested list is specific and not materially open to multiple interpretations.

evaluations.evidence: list basic information about my summit
evaluations.rationale: “Basic information” is vague and could include materially different fields depending on interpretation.

evaluations.evidence: list sponsors for my summit
evaluations.rationale: Clear requirement to display sponsors associated with a summit.

evaluations.evidence: list an agenda for my summit
evaluations.rationale: “Agenda” is underspecified (sessions list, timeslots, speakers, ordering, format), allowing different implementations.

evaluations.evidence: see how many seats are left for the summit
evaluations.rationale: Clear metric to display: remaining capacity for a summit.

evaluations.evidence: see specific details on summits
evaluations.rationale: “Specific details” is vague and can be interpreted as different sets of information (location, agenda, speakers, sponsors, logistics).

evaluations.evidence: see a list of all the summits
evaluations.rationale: The requested output is clear: a list of summits.

evaluations.evidence: learn about sponsorship levels
evaluations.rationale: The goal is clear: provide information describing sponsorship levels.

evaluations.evidence: all long-form content
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous what qualifies as “long-form content” (by content type, length threshold, specific fields), leading to different scope interpretations.

evaluations.evidence: Link to my sponsorship profile from my job listings
evaluations.rationale: Clear linkage requirement between job listings and the sponsor’s profile.

evaluations.evidence: learn about posting jobs as a sponsor and contact the sponsorship person
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous who/what “the sponsorship person” is (role, specific contact) and what “learn about” entails (page content, process steps, pricing).

evaluations.evidence: post a job
evaluations.rationale: The capability is clear: allow a sponsor to create a job posting.

evaluations.evidence: view the job board
evaluations.rationale: Clear action and object; no materially different interpretations.

evaluations.evidence: assign a room to a time slot and a location
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous distinction between “room” and “location” (room already implies location) and what “time slot” granularity/rules are.

evaluations.evidence: see the schedule
evaluations.rationale: The requested artifact (conference schedule) is clear in intent.

evaluations.evidence: final list of sessions approved
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous what “final” means (after which milestone) and what qualifies as “approved” (accepted only vs scheduled).

evaluations.evidence: bulk approve sessions as accepted
evaluations.rationale: Clear administrative action: accept multiple sessions at once.

evaluations.evidence: mark a session as accepted
evaluations.rationale: Clear single-session acceptance action.

evaluations.evidence: receive a notification when sessions have been evaluated
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous what “evaluated” means (scored, accepted/rejected decision, review completed) and notification channel (email, onsite, SMS).

evaluations.evidence: receive a notification when I submit a session
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous notification channel/content and what event counts as “submit” (draft saved vs final submission).

evaluations.evidence: edit my session
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous scope of editing (which fields, until when, after submission/acceptance) leading to different requirements.

evaluations.evidence: register to speak at BADCamp
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous whether this is account creation, speaker registration, or session submission; overlaps with separate “submit a session” stories.

evaluations.evidence: submit a session at BADCAMP
evaluations.rationale: Clear action: submit a session for evaluation.

evaluations.evidence: personalize my sponsorship page
evaluations.rationale: “Personalize” is vague and could mean editing content, branding, layout, media, or theming—materially different scopes.

evaluations.evidence: list of all the summits that include when they are
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous what “when they are” requires (date only vs date+time vs duration/timezone).

evaluations.evidence: several choices of idividual sponsorship on the second page of registration
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous what “several choices” means (how many/which) and which “registration” flow/page numbering applies.

evaluations.evidence: easily find a link in the menu
evaluations.rationale: “Easily find” is subjective and can be interpreted in materially different ways (menu location, labeling, prominence).

evaluations.evidence: fill out a user registration form
evaluations.rationale: Ambiguous required fields and whether this is site account registration vs event registration (both exist in backlog).

evaluations.evidence: find session information
evaluations.rationale: “Session information” is vague (title/abstract/speaker/time/room/track) and could be interpreted as search, browsing, or detail pages.
